package memory

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

type JobRepository struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	jobs  map[string]domain.PlanningJob
	byKey map[string]string
}

func NewJobRepository() *JobRepository {
	return &JobRepository{jobs: map[string]domain.PlanningJob{}, byKey: map[string]string{}}
}

func (repository *JobRepository) Ensure(ctx context.Context, job domain.PlanningJob) (domain.PlanningJob, bool, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, false, err
	}
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	if id, ok := repository.byKey[job.IdempotencyKey]; ok {
		stored := repository.jobs[id]
		if stored.RequestHash != job.RequestHash {
			return domain.PlanningJob{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return stored, false, nil
	}
	repository.jobs[job.ID] = job
	repository.byKey[job.IdempotencyKey] = job.ID
	return job, true, nil
}

func (repository *JobRepository) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.PlanningJob, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, err
	}
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	job, ok := repository.jobs[id]
	if !ok {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return job, nil
}

func (repository *JobRepository) Claim(ctx context.Context, id, token string, now time.Time, lease time.Duration) (domain.PlanningJob, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, err
	}
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	job, ok := repository.jobs[id]
	if !ok {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if job.Status == domain.JobStatusReady || job.Status == domain.JobStatusStaged {
		return job, nil
	}
	if (job.Status == domain.JobStatusGenerating || job.Status == domain.JobStatusVerifying) && job.LeaseExpiresAt != nil && job.LeaseExpiresAt.After(now) {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, domain.ErrLeaseHeld
	}
	if job.Attempts >= 5 {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: maximum authoring attempts reached", domain.ErrConflict)
	}
	expires := now.Add(lease)
	job.Status = domain.JobStatusGenerating
	job.Attempts++
	job.LeaseToken = token
	job.LeaseExpiresAt = &expires
	job.FailureCode = ""
	job.UpdatedAt = now
	repository.jobs[id] = job
	return job, nil
}

func (repository *JobRepository) RenewLease(ctx context.Context, id, token string, now time.Time, lease time.Duration) error {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	job, ok := repository.jobs[id]
	if !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if job.LeaseToken == "" || job.LeaseToken != token || job.Status != domain.JobStatusGenerating && job.Status != domain.JobStatusVerifying {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	expires := now.Add(lease)
	job.LeaseExpiresAt = &expires
	job.UpdatedAt = now
	repository.jobs[id] = job
	return nil
}

func (repository *JobRepository) MarkVerifying(ctx context.Context, id, token string, now time.Time) error {
	return repository.updateClaimed(ctx, id, token, func(job *domain.PlanningJob) { job.Status = domain.JobStatusVerifying; job.UpdatedAt = now })
}

func (repository *JobRepository) SaveReady(ctx context.Context, id, token string, artifact domain.AuthoringArtifact, now time.Time) error {
	return repository.updateClaimed(ctx, id, token, func(job *domain.PlanningJob) {
		job.Status = domain.JobStatusReady
		job.Artifact = &artifact
		job.FailureCode = ""
		job.LeaseToken = ""
		job.LeaseExpiresAt = nil
		job.UpdatedAt = now
	})
}

func (repository *JobRepository) SaveStaging(ctx context.Context, id string, staging domain.StagingReceiptV1, now time.Time) error {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	job, ok := repository.jobs[id]
	if !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if (job.Status != domain.JobStatusReady && job.Status != domain.JobStatusStaged) || job.Artifact == nil {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if job.Staging != nil {
		prior := *job.Staging
		prior.Created = staging.Created
		if prior == staging {
			return nil
		}
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	job.Status = domain.JobStatusStaged
	job.Staging = &staging
	job.UpdatedAt = now
	repository.jobs[id] = job
	return nil
}

func (repository *JobRepository) SaveFailed(ctx context.Context, id, token, code string, now time.Time) error {
	return repository.updateClaimed(ctx, id, token, func(job *domain.PlanningJob) {
		job.Status = domain.JobStatusFailed
		job.Artifact = nil
		job.FailureCode = code
		job.LeaseToken = ""
		job.LeaseExpiresAt = nil
		job.UpdatedAt = now
	})
}

func (repository *JobRepository) updateClaimed(ctx context.Context, id, token string, apply func(*domain.PlanningJob)) error {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	job, ok := repository.jobs[id]
	if !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if job.LeaseToken == "" || job.LeaseToken != token {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	apply(&job)
	repository.jobs[id] = job
	return nil
}

var _ domain.JobRepository = (*JobRepository)(nil)
